findings: Both final branches link to shared unet5 losses source; pointer files must be resolved before import.
BCE objective adds per-example symmetric mean and weighted corrected mean, then averages examples. Dice combines global weighted masses rather than averaging per-example ratios.
Final branch/fold predictions are accumulated as weighted sigmoid outputs. Weights are divided by fold count but not normalized across branches.
v43 branch weights sum to 1.099698088794955; v47 branch weights sum to 1.0871398222782643. Threshold 0.5 is applied to this unnormalized sum.

Training uses AdamW and loss division for accumulation; optimizer steps only on complete accumulation groups. Inspect remainder behavior and checkpoint epoch selection before lifecycle implementation.
